q1.explanationZh: have sports“进行体育活动”，sports 用复数。

q2.explanationZh: “去医院（看病）”= go to (the) hospital，the 可以省略。

q3.explanationZh: have no idea“不清楚；不知道”，相当于 don’t know。

q4.explanationZh: “去看电影”= go to the cinema，也可以说 go to the movie(s)。

q5.explanationZh: “实行节食”= go on a diet。

q6.explanationZh: “上课”= have a class，也可以说 have a lesson。

q7.explanationZh: go to bed“上床睡觉；就寝”，bed 前不加冠词。

q8.explanationZh: happen to do sth.“碰巧做某事”，to 后接动词原形。

q9.explanationZh: “继续做某事”= go on with sth.（后接名词）或 go on doing sth.（后接动词 -ing 形式）。

q10.explanationZh: hear of“听说”，过去式是 heard of。

q11.explanationZh: grow up“长大；成年”，过去式是 grew up。

q12.explanationZh: “去野餐”= go on a picnic，注意介词用 on。

q13.explanationZh: hear from sb.“收到某人的来信”，相当于 receive a letter from sb.。

q14.explanationZh: go to sleep“入睡；睡着”，与 go to bed（上床睡觉）不同。

q15.explanationZh: have a good time“玩得很愉快”，相当于 enjoy oneself。

q16.explanationZh: go out 有“外出”和“（灯、火）熄灭”两个意思。

q17.explanationZh: “不得不”= have to，也可以说 have got to，后接动词原形。

q18.explanationZh: “去观光”= go sightseeing，“go + 动词 -ing”表示去做某项活动。

q19.explanationZh: “吃早餐”= have breakfast，三餐名称前一般不加冠词。

q20.explanationZh: “去购物”= go shopping，shop 变 -ing 要双写 p。

q21.explanationZh: go over“复习；仔细地再读一遍”，相当于 review。

q22.explanationZh: happen to sb.“某人发生了某事”，主语是事情，不是人。

q23.explanationZh: “上学”= go to school，school 前不加 the。

q24.explanationZh: “怜悯某人”= have pity on sb.，介词用 on。

q25.explanationZh: “上大学”= go to college，college 前不加冠词。

q26.explanationZh: “继续”= go on，go on doing sth. 表示继续做某事；will 后用原形。

q27.explanationZh: Danny 超重，父母让他“节食”= go on a diet；tell sb. to do 后用原形。

q28.explanationZh: 灯“熄灭”用 go out；句子是过去时，要用过去式 went out。

q29.explanationZh: “从事（电影工作）”用 go in for；want sb. to do 后用原形。

q30.explanationZh: 电脑“出错；出问题”= go wrong；will 后用原形。

q31.explanationZh: 考试结束“上交”试卷用 hand in；Please 开头的祈使句用原形。

q32.explanationZh: “去野餐”= go on a picnic；will 后用原形。

q33.explanationZh: “不清楚该做什么”= have no idea what to do，主语 I 用 have。

q34.explanationZh: “听说”= hear of；last week 表示过去，用过去式 heard of。

q35.explanationZh: “最好还是”= had better，后接动词原形 surf。

q36.sampleAnswer: We often have sports in the afternoon.
references: We often have sports in the afternoon.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q36.explanationZh: “进行体育活动”= have sports；“常”用 often，放在实义动词前；“在下午”= in the afternoon。

q37.sampleAnswer: I am too excited to go to sleep.
references: I am too excited to go to sleep.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q37.explanationZh: “太……而不能……”用 too + 形容词 + to do：too excited to go to sleep。

q38.sampleAnswer: We had a very good time at the evening party.
references: We had a very good time at the evening party.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q38.explanationZh: “玩得很愉快”= have a good time，说的是过去的事，用 had；“在晚会上”= at the evening party。

q39.sampleAnswer: I would like all my children to go to college.
references: I would like all my children to go to college.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q39.explanationZh: “希望某人做某事”可用 would like sb. to do sth.；“进大学”= go to college。

q40.sampleAnswer: We go to school to get knowledge about many different things.
references: We go to school to get knowledge about many different things.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q40.explanationZh: “上学”= go to school；“为了……”用动词不定式 to get… 表示目的。

q41.sampleAnswer: Most students in our class go in for scientific activities.
references: Most students in our class go in for scientific activities.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q41.explanationZh: “参加”= go in for；主语 Most students 是复数，动词用原形 go。

q42.sampleAnswer: Children must be educated to serve their country when they grow up.
references: Children must be educated to serve their country when they grow up.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q42.explanationZh: “必须教育孩子”用被动语态 Children must be educated；“长大后”= when they grow up。

q43.sampleAnswer: I hear that Hainan is a good place to go sightseeing.
references: I hear that Hainan is a good place to go sightseeing.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q43.explanationZh: “观光的好地方”= a good place to go sightseeing，不定式作定语修饰 place。

q44.sampleAnswer: You may fail to pass the examination unless you do your best to go over the lessons.
references: You may fail to pass the examination unless you do your best to go over the lessons.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q44.explanationZh: “除非”= unless；“尽全力做某事”= do one’s best to do sth.；“复习”= go over。

q45.sampleAnswer: You’d better read English newspapers more often if you want to improve your reading ability.
references: You’d better read English newspapers more often if you want to improve your reading ability.
You had better read English newspapers more often if you want to improve your reading ability.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q45.explanationZh: “最好还是做某事”= had better do sth.，可缩写为 ’d better；“如果”用 if 引导条件句。
